hero.title: Reserve Your Prairie Experience
hero.lead: To keep the ranch calm and every guest safe, Bách Mã Viên limits the number of guests per time slot. Please complete the form below so our concierge team can welcome you properly.

form.step1: Choose a Date and Time Slot

benefits.coach: A dedicated 1:1 trainer for your entire time in the saddle.
benefits.gear: CE-certified helmet and protective boots, free in your size.
benefits.drink: A local herbal welcome drink with crisp roasted-nut biscuits.
benefits.photo: Free check-in photos against the rustic Wild West timber setting.

sidebar.policyText: You can change your date or time free of charge up to 12 hours before departure. In stormy weather Bách Mã Viên will happily move your booking.
sidebar.locationTag: Meeting Point on the Cổ Cò Riverside
sidebar.locationText: Only 15 minutes from Hội An old town and 25 minutes from central Đà Nẵng. A space apart from the dust of the city.
